buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic

Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Sr. DFM JBP WCR Account No. 36903591229 IFSC Code SBIN0000390 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address Civil Line Jabalpur . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr. DRM WCR JBP A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Special condition of work Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply) is to be done at following address Sport utility vehicle for DEN East JBP at Jabalpur. 1. The following condition shall apply for the pur pose of this contract. (a) Day" means a calendar day starting from 00 hours to 24 hour.

2. PERIOD OF CONTRACT 2.1 Contract will be valid for 24 (twenty four ) months from the date of acceptance. 2.2 Railway reserves the right to close the contract as per extant norms. 3. The contract shall supply vehicle in good and perfect working condition; utility vehicle shall be maintain ed in good condition throughout the period of the validity of contract so as to ensure satisfactory service u nder the contract. Railway shall have the right to reject the vehicle if not found suitable as per above. 4. Tenderer shall necessarily indicate following, regarding the offered vehicle. (a) Type of utility vehicle (M aruti SuzukiErtiga/ Mahindra XUV 500/ Maruti Suzuki XL6/ Ford Ecosport/ MahindraXUV 300/Mahindra Scor pio or similar segment as per Gem) (b) Year of model (not earlier than year 2025) 5. Contractor shall quote rate as per "Scope of Work" as mentioned in the Bid. The rate shall include the fol lowing (a) All maintenances expenditure of the vehicle i.e major and minor repair required for good runnin g of the vehicle, cleaning. lubricants, all consumable other than diesel which shall be included as per Para (2)below (b) Rate shall include cost of diesel/petrol for running of vehicle as per scheduled items for the du ration of contract. (c) Rate shall include salary and other charges of two drivers including EPF, ESIC etc. to be paid to the drivers (d) Rate shall include payments to RTO, labour authorities. local municipal authoritie s Taxes. Toll tax Levies, fees and all the other charges which are necessary for continuance of the services under the contract. (e) Any other charges required for execution of this contract. 6. Payment to the service provider will be made only upon production of documentary evidence for deposit ion of EPF & ESIC for both drivers. 7. In case Drivers have to make night halt at an out stationi.e.at the place other than HQ to which the vehi cle is attached, no extra payment shall be admissible in that case. (3) In case there is Diesel/petrol hike du ring the contract period No extra payment on this account will paid. Attachment of vehicle can be changed as &when required by Railway which shall be informed in writing. 8. The Head Quarter of the Vehicle shall be at Divisional Engineer East Jabalpur. 9.Availability of vehicle to be ensured throughout the validity of Contract (24 X7), 10. Contractor shall maintain a record for daily meter reading which shall jointly signed by the Railway offi cial using the vehicle and driver of the vehicle. It will be the responsibility of the driver of the vehicle to ens ure that the daily kilometer reading are properly filled in and any over writing/cutting should be got authe nticated by the officer using the vehicle. 11. Contractor shall ensure that enough fuel is available in the Vehicle all the time, Contractor shall ensure that all the meters particularly KM, fuel and devices of vehicle are in Proper working condition. In case due to any circumstances any defects got developed and are pointed out by Railway authority s, repairs and re placement necessary should be carried out immediately by the contractor at his own cost. The contractor shall ensure that the vehicle is available every day. Contractor shall provide a good condition spare wheel and tools kit with the vehicle. The vehicle shall normally be used in DEN East on all type of road i.e. Pucca Kutcha service road etc. and depending upon the requirement of DEN East. 12. The sectional jurisdiction of DEN/East Jabalpur is spread between Katni to Singrauli, which will be frequ ently visited including night stay. The contractor should quote rates accordingly. However in case of any re quired urgency vehicle may be used other than KTE-SGRL jurisdiction as per decision of DEN/East/ JBP. 13.Any claim, compensation arising out of any accident/injury to any person/party will be the liability of co ntractors and / or any litigation arising out of running /accident of vehicle or due to the person employed b y the contractor etc. shall be dealt by contractor himself at his own cost. Railway will not bear any liability on any account. 14. Regulations/Compliance of labour laws, hours of employment, Insurance and any other Act. / Provision etc. enforced from time to time, will be the duty / responsibility of the contractor. West Central Railway will be using the vehicle as a passenger only. 15. The vehicle shall be parked at place decided by DEN/East/JBP

16. Along with bid, the bidder has to submit the Annexure –D attached at scope of work. Non submissio n of the same will lead to summarily rejection of their bid. Special Condition: 1. All messages will be conveyed by DEN East JBP. 2. Contractor should have a good communication system available with the driver and himself. 3. The distance (KM) shall be calculated as per actual meter reading/log book by shortest route. 4. If, any toll tax/ Nakha arises, should be paid by the contractor at his own. 5. In case of failure of the vehicle, the arrangement for the alternative vehicle is to be made by the contrac tor immediately within 60 minutes failing which no charges will be paid for that day and the contractor sha ll be penalized with Rs.1000/- per day and the penalty shall be deducted from the contractor's bill.6. The c ontractor shall be liable to be fined up to sum of Rs.1000/- per day at the sole discretion of the administrati on for each act of misconduct on the part of the contractor or on the part of any of his / their agents / drive r or workmen to observe or to perform any of the terms and conditions of contract, the imposition of any s uch fine shall not affect but shall be without prejudice to the other rights and remedies of the administratio n under this agreement or by General law. Any appeal against such fine shall be made to the DEN/East/Jab alpur/West Central Railway, or his representative whose decision on the contractor's appeal shall be final a nd binding. 7. As an alternative to para 5 of special conditions , due to contractor's failure to provide alternative vehicl e for more than 60 minutes, Railway administration shall have liberty to arrange any other vehicle and the expenditure incurred by the Railway in arranging alternative vehicle will be deducted from the contractor's bill. . 9.
